test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A person borrows ₹20,000 at 25% compound interest per year, compounded annually. At the end of every year, he pays ₹2,500 as part payment. How much does he still owe after two such instalments?
solution:
**Given**

Principal (P) = ₹20,000

Rate of interest (R) = 25% 

Annual part payment = ₹2,500

**Formula Used**

Amount after n years = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ - Part payment using the structure of compound interest

**Calculation**

For the first year:

⇒ Amount after 1 year = 20,000 × (1 + 25/100)¹ - 2,500

⇒ A1 = 20,000 × 1.25 - 2,500

⇒ A1 = 25,000 - 2,500

⇒ A1 = 22,500

For the second year ⇒ P2 = 22,500

⇒ Amount after 2nd year = 22,500 × (1 + 25/100)¹ - 2,500

⇒ A2 = 22,500 × 1.25 - 2,500

⇒ A2 = 28,125 - 2,500

⇒ A2 = 25,625

**The amount owed after two installments is ₹25,625.**
